summary: Phase-2 Spaces testing (backend + frontend). Backend: 40/40 pytest cases pass — Phase-1 regression (22) + new Spaces suite (18) covering audio library, space CRUD, content (YouTube parsing + audio), state sync with host_id, messages, reactions, space_invite chat message, leave, and WebSocket (snapshot + presence broadcast + invalid-token rejection). Frontend: logged in as Ava, walked Spaces tab → create → enter room → add YouTube → add audio (Rain & Jazz) → reactions → chat overlay → leave, all succeeded. Also validated chat shared-space-pill flow: tap pill → creates a new space + space_invite message → navigates into /space/[id] → WebSocket wss://.../api/ws/spaces/{id}?token=… opens cleanly → leave → returns to chat where 4 join-space-<id> cards now render correctly.

issues: YouTube mode shows the text 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' instead of an iframe when running in the Expo web preview. This is a web-only limitation of react-native-webview (the package simply does not implement a web target here) and per the agent-to-agent context note this is a known limitation NOT to flag — it will work on iOS/Android. Flagging only for awareness so main agent knows 'youtube-player' visibility cannot be verified from web Playwright.

react_native_issues.issue: Spec/problem-statement lists the 6 emojis as [❤️, 😂, 👏, 🔥, 😢, ✨]; actual implementation uses [❤️, 😂, 🔥, 👏, 🌙, ✨] (🌙 replaces 😢 and the order of 👏/🔥 is swapped). testIDs reaction-❤️..reaction-✨ are all present; reaction-😢 does NOT exist, reaction-🌙 does. Minor spec divergence — main agent to confirm which is canonical.

action_items: (Optional) Decide whether to match the spec reaction set (swap 🌙 back to 😢) or update the spec to reflect the current 🌙 choice.
(Already called out in context note) YouTube WebView does not render on web preview — testing must be done on iOS/Android for that feature. No code change required.
(Carried over from iteration 3) shadow* style deprecation warnings — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~930 lines and mixes auth/chats/spaces. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, chats.py, spaces.py) once Phase-2.x lands — not urgent.

space_ws handler broadcasts the join event before sending the snapshot which means the newly-connected client receives its own presence.join before snapshot. Frontend handles this fine, but it means tests must drain, not assume ordering.

/api/spaces/{id}/leave unsets presence and conditionally writes a space_sessions doc when presence becomes empty, but the WebSocket disconnect path ALSO unsets presence — if a user only uses WS (never calls /leave) the session summary branch in the HTTP leave endpoint is bypassed. Works for current UI (space-leave calls both) but worth documenting.
_yt_id regex rejects bare 11-char ids (e.g. if a user pastes only 'dQw4w9WgXcQ') — currently that returns 400. Consider accepting raw ids as a convenience.
SpaceReactionIn has no validation on emoji content — any string up to 8 chars is accepted and broadcast. Fine for a trusted demo.
spaces list response does not include the last 'content' preview which would help the 'Your Rooms' list show what was last playing. Nice-to-have.
